question: An isolated parallel plate capacitor (capacitance $C_0$, charge $Q_0$) has a stored energy $U_0$. A dielectric slab of constant $K=3$, having the same dimensions as the space between the plates, is held at rest at the edge of the capacitor. If the slab is released, it is pulled into the capacitor. Assuming no friction, what is the kinetic energy of the slab when it is fully inside the capacitor?
